relationships.subject: TRPA1
relationships.evidence_quote: Vo WDR neuronal activity was attenuated by subcutaneous injection of the TRPA1 antagonist into the whisker pad in PNL rats.

relationships.subject: TG-Vo neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Optogenetic stimulation of TG-Vo neurons in naïve rats induced a significantly increased frequency of freezing behavior and decreased MHWT.

key_findings: Optogenetic stimulation of TG-Vo neurons evoked freezing and mechanical hypersensitivity; Vo deactivation reversed PNL hypersensitivity.
CGRP- and TRPA1-positive TG-Vo neurons increased after nerve injury and TRPA1 antagonism reduced Vo WDR activity.
